steps.setupDrawTurn: First, the table is fixed to a small teaching state so we can focus on the two formal actions of a turn.
steps.welcome: In Fantasy Realms, each turn really has only two actions: draw a card, then discard a card; or take a card from the public center row, then discard a card.
steps.deckIntro: This is the deck. When the public row is not attractive enough, you draw from here.
steps.centerRowIntro: This middle row is the open discard. It represents the second action: skip the deck, take one of these cards, then discard a card.
steps.drawFromDeck: Draw from the deck first. In duel mode, an undersized hand draws 2 and keeps 1, so a discard is guaranteed next.
steps.discardAfterDraw: Now discard Bell Tower. After drawing, this turn still requires one discard.
steps.setupTakeCenter: Next, look at the second formal action: take from the public center row, then close the turn with a discard.
steps.takeCenterCard: This time, do not draw from the deck. Take Bell Tower directly from the center row.
steps.discardAfterCenter: After taking from the center row, discard the Magic Wand to finish the turn.
steps.turnLoop: That is the real match loop: each turn you choose one of two action lines, draw-and-discard or take-from-center-and-discard.
steps.endgameRule: In multiplayer, the game ends when the public discard reaches its threshold. In duel, both hands must be refilled and the discard threshold must also be reached.
steps.finish: The basic tutorial is complete. You have now played through the two core Fantasy Realms actions: draw and discard, and take from the center row then discard.
